title: Pocket Pet Star Camp

selected_categories.reasoning: The dominant loop is caring for a chosen pet through need-related actions, with hunger, hygiene, and fun meters acting as the core simulation layer.
One of the three major activities is a jump-over-obstacles race sequence, which partially matches obstacle-avoidance runner gameplay.
The race minigame rewards quick timing and reactive jumping, but it is only one subsystem rather than the full game identity.
The cleaning minigame is built around rubbing away dirt for immediate visual payoff, fitting a light satisfying-interaction pattern.
The overall structure is not a true clicker, but repeated simple interactions steadily fill meters and convert into rewards in a casual progression loop.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not include a direct 'virtual pet minigame collection' label, so the lower-ranked picks are approximate partial matches.
The game mixes care simulation with three different microgame styles, making the strongest first match much clearer than the remaining four.
The race subsystem could also be loosely read as 'Lane runner game' or 'Endless runner', but the presentation is simpler than those categories usually imply.
